title: Nvidia Is in Talks to Value Perplexity at More Than $30 Billion
key_facts: The Information reports Nvidia is discussing an equity investment in Perplexity AI at a valuation above $30 billion.
Perplexity was valued at about $20 billion a year ago and about $23 billion in a Series E that closed in January 2026.
No deal is final, the size of Nvidia's check is undisclosed and neither company has commented.
Perplexity's annualized revenue run rate has reportedly crossed $750 million, up from under $250 million at the start of 2026; Startup Fortune says no one has confirmed it.
At $30 billion the price is about 40 times that run rate; Perplexity is not profitable.
Nvidia already backs Perplexity from earlier rounds.
Startup Fortune says critics call Nvidia's investments circular financing; Nvidia has denied that.
quote_evidence: Nvidia is discussing an equity investment in Perplexity AI that would value the search startup at more than $30 billion, according to a report from The Information.
No deal is final, and the size of Nvidia's check hasn't been disclosed.
Nvidia has denied that this amounts to circular financing.
why_it_matters_hint: Talks would add to Nvidia's growing list of investments in AI companies at a very high revenue multiple.
notes: Read Startup Fortune, which relays The Information; the original was not opened. Revenue figure unconfirmed. The article also mixes in unrelated items (IREN, Reflection AI) which were ignored.
